name: Clos de la Roche
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Clos de la Roche (#461). None establishes current farming.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 673.577408 m² remainder (0.3986%) was reviewed against the pinned INAO boundary and Chambolle-Musigny and Morey-Saint-Denis cadastres. The remainder is narrow strips along the cru's edges; on the northern side the official line runs past the Morey-Saint-Denis cadastre into Gevrey-Chambertin parcels, which are measured but never imported. It forms 12 pieces, with mean widths of 0.07–1.29 m for those of at least 1 m². All of it lies along the outline edge. It is not a missing INAO commune. Neighbouring Gevrey-Chambertin parcels account for 456.622061 m² of it. 216.955347 m² is covered by no audited parcel. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.

namedPlots.coverageNote: Clos de la Roche, Les Chabiots, Les Fremières, Les Froichots, Les Genavrières, Les Mochamps and Monts Luisants are cadastral named areas within Clos de la Roche; only part of the cadastral Les Genavrières and Monts Luisants lies inside the cru. Outlines follow the cadastre inside the official boundary, with small gaps retained; they do not show producer holdings. A label naming only the cru keeps the whole-cru outline.

unresolved.reason: LES CHAFFOTS is an official Clos Saint-Denis climat, not a Clos de la Roche one. Parcel AB0419 lies 86% inside Clos de la Roche (and 10% in Clos Saint-Denis) but in that lieu-dit; AB0418 and AB0474 only touch the edge. No crosswalk is made; these parcels keep the whole-cru outline.

neighbouringLieuxDits.reason: Not an official Clos de la Roche climat. It holds most of parcels that only touch the cru edge; they stay cru parcels for rights and history, with no named area.
